{"edit_description":"Create a NEW complete single-file HTML page named for a glowing neural-network growth simulation. No build step, no modules — one <script> with vanilla JS. Use ONLY these external references: dat.gui loaded via <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat.gui/0.7.9/dat.gui.min.js"></script>. Nothing else external, no images/textures/fonts.

PAGE SHELL
- Body background #05070f, flex-centered, min-height 100vh, margin 0.
- One <canvas id="c" width="800" height="800">, centered, with a subtle 1px rgba(0,229,255,0.15) border and faint box-shadow.
- Exact neon palette constants in JS: BG '#05070f', BG_GLOW '#101a3a', BRANCH '#00e5ff', ACCENT '#d6ff00', SYNAPSE '#ff2bd6', PULSE '#fff36a', UI '#ffd400', GRID 'rgba(0,229,255,0.08)'.

PARAMS (defaults) + dat.gui
- params object: neuronCount 4, growthSpeed 2, maxDepth 8, splitChance 0.75, curvature 0.35, maxBranchLength 160, synapseDistance 24, synapseGlow 14, pulseSpeed 0.9, pulseFrequency 1.2, pulseBrightness 1.0, backgroundColor '#05070f', branchColor '#00e5ff', accentColor '#d6ff00', synapseColor '#ff2bd6', pulseColor '#fff36a', glowAmount 10, scanlines true.
- dat.gui with folders:
  - "Growth": neuronCount (3–6 step 1), growthSpeed (0.2–6), maxDepth (3–12 step 1), splitChance (0–1), curvature (0–1), maxBranchLength (40–400).
  - "Synapses": synapseDistance (5–80), synapseGlow (0–40).
  - "Pulses": pulseSpeed (0.05–3), pulseFrequency (0.05–6), pulseBrightness (0–2).
  - "Visuals": backgroundColor, branchColor, accentColor, synapseColor, pulseColor (addColor), glowAmount (0–30), scanlines (boolean).
  - Root buttons: "regenerate network" -> regenerate(); "clear canvas" -> clearAll(); "pause/resume animation" -> togglePause() (button name can be static 'Pause / Resume Animation').
- Small optional dat.gui CSS accent override using #ffd400 for .dg .cr.number input etc. is fine, keep minimal.

SIMULATION STATE (plain arrays/objects)
- neurons: seeds array {x, y, accent:false} — params.neuronCount random points within ~140px of canvas center (400,400).
- branches: array of {x, y, angle, depth, grown, maxLen, width, accent, neuron:i, pts:[{x,y}], done:false}. Active branches grow step-by-step each frame (NOT instantly): angle += (Math.random()-0.5)*curvature; step = growthSpeed*1.2; x+=cos(angle)*step; y+=sin(angle)*step; push point; grown+=step. Vary width slightly (0.6–1.8), thinner at deeper depth. Accent flag ~25% of branches uses accent color.
- Splitting: while growing, when grown passes 40% of maxLen and Math.random()<splitChance*0.03 and depth<maxDepth and branches.length<MAX_BRANCHES(700): branch stops (done) and spawns 2 child branches at angle ± (0.4–1.0 rad) with depth+1, maxLen*0.75, width*0.75. Also occasionally (Math.random()<0.012) spawn one smaller side branch (depth+1, maxLen*0.5, width*0.6) while parent keeps growing.
- Branch finishes when grown>=maxLen or leaves a 30px margin. When ALL branches are done, growth stops (stable network).
- tips: derived from finished branches' last point; each tip keeps reference to its neuron index.

SYNAPSE DETECTION
- Each frame during growth, compare active/finished branch endpoints pairwise (skip same branch); if dist < synapseDistance and pair key "i|j" not in a Set (prevents duplicates), push synapse {ax,ay,bx,by,neuronA,neuronB,phase:Math.random()*6.28} and record key. Favor cross-neuron tips (connect if different neurons at full threshold, same neuron only under half threshold) — keep this one-line simple.
- Synapses glow softly and pulse over time via sin(time*2+phase).

PULSES
- pulses array {s:synapse, t, dir}. Spawn randomly while synapses exist: if Math.random() < pulseFrequency*dt and pulses.length<40, pick random synapse + random dir. t += dir*pulseSpeed*dt; remove when t>1 or t<0.
- Position: linear interpolation (lerp) between synapse endpoints with small perpendicular sinusoidal jitter for an electric-spark feel; draw a short fading trail (store last ~6 positions or draw a gradient line segment behind the spark).
- After growth ends, this continues forever — scene stays alive; randomly different synapses light up.

RENDERING (each frame, requestAnimationFrame; dt clamped to 0.05)
- Fill params.backgroundColor.
- Background glow: radial gradient centered at canvas center, BG_GLOW at ~0.55 alpha fading to transparent, radius ~450.
- Grid: vertical+horizontal lines every 50px, strokeStyle GRID (rgba(0,229,255,0.08)), 1px.
- Branches: for each branch, one path — moveTo pts[0], then smooth quadratic curves through midpoints of consecutive points (quadraticCurveTo(p[i].x, p[i].y, midX, midY)); strokeStyle = accent?accentColor:branchColor; lineWidth=width; shadowColor same color; shadowBlur=glowAmount; lineCap 'round'.
- Neuron somas: filled glowing circles radius ~5 at seeds (branchColor, shadowBlur 20) plus tiny inner white-ish core (rgba(255,255,255,0.8) radius 2).
- Synapses: faint connecting line between endpoints (synapseColor, alpha ~0.12, no shadow), then glowing dot at the midpoint: radius 2.5+1.2*sin(time*2+phase), fillStyle synapseColor, shadowColor synapseColor, shadowBlur = synapseGlow*(0.7+0.3*sin(...)) — brighter than branches.
- Pulses: bright moving sparks — fillStyle pulseColor, shadowColor pulseColor, shadowBlur = 12*pulseBrightness, circle radius ~2.5*pulseBrightness plus a short fading trail; optionally tiny random flicker.
- Scanlines (if params.scanlines): every 3px horizontal 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.16) lines with a slowly drifting y offset ((time*6)%3) — cheap loop of fillRects.
- Vignette: final radial gradient overlay, transparent center to rgba(5,7,15,0.85) at corners.
- Reset shadowBlur=0 after glow passes.

LOOP / BUTTONS
- regenerate(): clear arrays + synapse keys Set, create params.neuronCount new seeds near center, spawn one initial branch per neuron pointing outward at random angle (maxLen = maxBranchLength, depth 0, width 1.6), resume growing.
- clearAll(): empty branches/synapses/pulses, repaint background only.
- togglePause(): boolean paused flag — when paused, skip updates AND freeze simulation time (still redraw so GUI color edits show live); dt ignored while paused.
- Start with regenerate() on load.

CODE STRUCTURE — keep compact, organized with clear section comments: // ---- setup ----, // ---- gui ----, // ---- growth ----, // ---- synapse detection ----, // ---- pulse animation ----, // ---- rendering ----, // ---- main loop ----. Short comments only. No mention of any game, movie, brand or copyrighted visual style anywhere (code, comments, page title — use a neutral title like "Neon Neural Growth"). Keep everything performant: no per-pixel loops, no heavy particles, reuse gradients where cheap, shadowBlur only on strokes/dots.","path":"neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
